title: Simple French Apple Tart
summary: A classic French-style apple tart with a buttery crust, tender sliced apples, and a light apricot-style sweetness from simple sugar syrup? Actually kept very simple with cinnamon and sugar. Best served warm or at room temperature with cream or custard.

ingredients.name: apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced

steps: Make the pastry by rubbing the cold butter into the plain flour and salt until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs.
Stir in the sugar, then add the egg yolk and cold water and mix just until the dough comes together.
Shape into a disc, wrap, and chill for 20 minutes.
Roll the pastry out and line a tart tin, then trim the edges and prick the base all over with a fork.
Toss the apple slices with sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice.
Arrange the apples neatly over the tart shell in overlapping circles.
Brush the apples lightly with melted butter and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the pastry is golden and the apples are soft and lightly caramelised.
Cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
